title: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal
summary: This one pan apple baked oatmeal is so easy to make with 6 ingredients. It is egg-free and dairy-free and can be made ahead of time.
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce (110g) OR 1 medium banana, mashed
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 8 inch square pan.
Add all the ingredients and stir to combine. Add the apples on top.
